answer_1.quote: We introduce BIOREADER, a novel text-to-text biomedical language model fusing memory retrieval and generative components ... we fine‑tune BIOREADER on 18 widespread NLP human‑annotated biomedical datasets ... including Question answering and Open-domain QA where the model generates free‑form answers.
answer_1.outputs: Free‑form text answers for QA/OpenQA and other generated sequences

answer_2.quote: We evaluate the predicted free text with the Exact Match metric ... For NER we use entity‑level F1, for RE F1 per class, for NLI accuracy, and for document classification F1‑score.

answer_4.quote: We hire three expert human annotators proficient in English and with biomedical competencies to manually scrutinize model predictions ... we ask the graders to (i) binary label the scientific accuracy (factual correctness) of the generated answers, (ii) assess language fluency on a 3‑point Likert scale.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators label scientific accuracy (binary) and rate language fluency on a 3‑point Likert scale.
